name: school-management-system
description: Monorepo root for School Management System

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix FrontendFees && npm install --prefix ServerFees && npm install --prefix ahey-master && npm install --prefix Bulletin_backend && npm install --prefix Bulletin_frontend && npm install --prefix bff
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start-api" "npm run start-server-fees" "npm run start-ahey" "npm run start-bulletins-backend" "npm run dev-frontend" "npm run dev-frontend-fees" "npm run dev-bulletins-frontend"
